samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: In situations related to online university classes, some learners may feel isolated. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?
requirementsVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp xử lý đúng nguyên nhân.
Nêu cách thực hiện và điều kiện.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons, a practical difficulty is that some learners may feel isolated. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu đúng vấn đề được hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. This can help explain why some learners may feel isolated. Consider the following situation: a first-year student may stop working on a difficult task instead of asking a classmate for help. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nối điều kiện tổ chức với vấn đề.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. For example, a teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hành động cụ thể có ví dụ thực hiện.

paragraphs.label: Vì sao giải pháp đáng làm?
paragraphs.text: The aim is not to abandon the useful parts of the idea. It is to make them accessible in practice. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. This illustrates the potential value of the fact that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. Asking participants what prevents them from benefiting would help organisers choose changes that actually matter.
paragraphs.noteVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the problem is linked to the fact that courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. A practical response is to schedule small weekly discussion groups. Trying this carefully and listening to the people affected is more convincing than expecting a general instruction to solve the difficulty on its own.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tóm tắt nguyên nhân–giải pháp tương ứng.

samples.title: Thư viện trường

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that libraries sometimes buy resources without asking students what they need. This can help explain why new books may remain unused. Consider the following situation: a younger reader may give up when the only books on display are too difficult. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

For example, a librarian could show each class where to find simple reference books and offer a weekly reading recommendation. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

paragraphs.label: Vì sao giải pháp đáng làm?

For example, two students can use a library reference book to prepare a science presentation after school. paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that teachers may set similar tasks without considering the total workload across subjects. This can help explain why too much homework can take time away from rest and family life. Consider the following situation: a pupil sharing one room with younger siblings may find a long evening assignment difficult to finish. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. For example, five carefully chosen maths questions can reveal whether a pupil knows how to use a new method. paragraphs.noteVi: Tư vấn học nghề mở thêm lựa chọn; cần hiểu nội dung học và điều kiện làm việc trước khi chọn.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, the problem is linked to the fact that career advice sometimes focuses on prestige instead of the details of each route. A practical response is to provide course visits and balanced guidance about work and further study. Trying this carefully and listening to the people affected is more convincing than expecting a general instruction to solve the difficulty on its own.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that communities should provide more affordable classes for adults, a practical difficulty is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu đúng vấn đề được hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that course providers may focus on fees while overlooking practical access. This can help explain why people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. Consider the following situation: a parent may miss an evening class because there is no one available to look after a child. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nối điều kiện tổ chức với vấn đề.

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to offer flexible schedules and simple support for attendance. For example, a centre could repeat the same lesson at two different times and provide materials for missed sessions. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hành động cụ thể có ví dụ thực hiện.

paragraphs.label: Vì sao giải pháp đáng làm?
paragraphs.text: The aim is not to abandon the useful parts of the idea. It is to make them accessible in practice. For example, a shop assistant can attend an evening computer class to learn how to manage simple spreadsheets.
